prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a pet archetype to preview live animations and desktop behaviors in real time.", "Select Archetype"]
2: ["Mastering Desktop Pet Controls", "Quick guide on how to interact with your pet once it arrives on your screen.", "Press Alt+P to toggle visibility\nRight-click pet for main menu\nDrag pet to move across screens"]
3: ["Adopt an Instant Companion or Build Custom", "Choose a ready-to-use desktop pet for instant setup, or customize your pet using photos.", "Instant Ready Pet", "Custom Photo Pet"]
4: ["Sign in with your primary account to keep and sync your desktop pets safely."]
5: ["Setting Up Desktop Pet Environment...", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and loading pet graphics engine.", "Checking screen overlay permissions...", "Tip: If pet does not appear, check your system tray menu."]
6: ["How Should Your Pet Assist You?", "Select Companion Mode for relaxed fun, or Productivity Mode for focus timers and work reminders.", "Continue Setup"]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready to Join Your Desktop!", "Click below to spawn your companion live on screen.", "Launch Pet Now"]
8: ["We will send a desktop alert when your custom pet rendering finishes!"]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your new pet comes with 3 bonus starter items: Desktop Bed, Toy Ball, and Snack Pack.", "Bonus Starter Pack Included"]
